description: This file defines the ConvertBinary class, which provides static methods for converting binary numbers to decimal, hexadecimal, and octal representations within the PhpSpreadsheet calculation library. It handles binary input validation, supports array inputs for batch processing, and implements two's complement handling for negative binary numbers.

classes.name: ConvertBinary
classes.description: A class providing static methods for converting binary strings to decimal, hexadecimal, and octal formats, with input validation and support for array inputs.

methods.name: toDecimal
methods.description: Converts a binary string or array of binary strings to decimal numbers, handling sign via two's complement.

methods.name: toHex
methods.description: Converts a binary string or array of binary strings to hexadecimal, with optional zero-padding and two's complement handling.

methods.name: toOctal
methods.description: Converts a binary string or array of binary strings to octal, including two's complement for negative numbers.

methods.name: validateBinary
methods.description: Validates that a binary string is at most 10 bits long and contains only 0s and 1s.
